card.name: Recovery linked to stopping the drug
card.fires_on: Small linking words or verbs such as when, after, if, with, follows, improve, right after a reversible or resolving effect, where the next words are about stopping or discontinuing treatment.

modes.label: Reversible when stopped
modes.description: Words like when, with, or if follow 'reversible' or 'remit' and lead into discontinuation of the drug.

modes.label: Recovery after discontinuation
modes.description: Words like after, follows, or improve follow 'recovered', 'resolution', or 'improve' and lead into discontinuation.
modes.example: Most patients recovered<< after>> discontinuation of treatment, but some patients

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words about stopping or removing, such as stop, cessation, and removal.
card.plain: It fires on the small word that comes just before 'discontinuation' when a label says a side effect goes away once the drug is stopped.
